units.prompt_text:
Identity: the person in @image1, exactly; same face and costume as the reference for the whole clip; no rings, watches, microphones or accessories that are not in the reference.
Setting: outside a corner shop on a pavement (generic, unrecognisable). Passers-by, if any, are soft blurred shapes who never react.
Camera: starts medium portrait, centred, seated eye level, 9:16; propped phone with one small settle-wobble in the first second, then locked.
Props (exact design, exactly one of each, nothing else added): white folding plastic garden chair; large wooden scoring paddle with a 0-10 dial; closed plain umbrella (no logo) across his knees; passer-by's open plain dark umbrella (generic, no logo, passer-by only a blurred edge figure); rain (top edge, then falling); grey corner-shop wall with blank unreadable shutter.
Hands: at most two hands act; each named hand does one thing; the other hand rests where stated; every object is either held or resting on a surface; one interaction per shot; state changes happen across the hard cuts, never mid-shot.
Physics: each held object stays in a named hand or rests on a surface; nothing floats or vanishes; mouth closed on anything in it; feet grounded except described steps; everything else holds still.
0-6s: Left hand grips the paddle shaft upright on his left thigh, right palm flat on the closed umbrella across his lap, body and chair still. Uncle Verdict says once: "Umbrella. Two out of ten. Correct answer: a tiny roof for nobody.".
6-9s: Rain starts: drops darken his bald crown and the paddle; a stranger's open dark umbrella slides past the right frame edge; his left hand keeps the paddle upright on his thigh, body still. Camera: propped phone.
9-10.5s: Left hand lifts the paddle toward the lens, dial clearly at 2; right palm stays flat on the umbrella in his lap; body still on the chair; rain falling. Camera: propped phone. Hard cut to.
10.5-12s: Left hand holds the paddle up at the lens, dial already at 1; right palm flat on the umbrella in his lap; body still; rain falling. Camera: propped phone. Uncle Verdict says once: "Final.".
Sound: only the quoted lines are spoken, each exactly once, then silence; quiet street ambience, distant traffic, faint wind; no music.
No readable text, logos or signage except a product's own label. Natural skin, no blur on the face. No third arm, no extra hands, no duplicated limbs, no extra fingers, no deformed hands; objects never merge with hands; exactly one of each prop; no mirrors or reflections; no slow motion.
units.prompt_text_full:
TOP PRIORITY (read first):
1. Face and identity match @image1 100% for the entire take; identity reference ONLY, never its lighting.
2. Speak ONLY the quoted lines, in English, lips still when no line is spoken.
3. Props exist from frame one and never appear, disappear or change design: white folding plastic garden chair, large wooden scoring paddle with a 0-10 dial, closed plain umbrella (no logo) across his knees, passer-by's open plain dark umbrella (generic, no logo, passer-by only a blurred edge figure), rain (top edge, then falling), grey corner-shop wall with blank unreadable shutter.
4. Never staged, never stiff, never puppet-like; the comedy is in disproportion, not mugging.
5. No readable brand text, logos or signage anywhere in frame.
=== REFERENCE KEY === @image1 character reference; @image2 location still (scene reference only).
CHARACTER: Round soft face, heavy-lidded calm eyes, neat salt-and-pepper beard trimmed short, bald shining crown with a ring of grey hair, slow blink, serene half-smile that never changes. Costume: Mustard-yellow three-piece suit slightly too big, open collar, brown leather loafers with no socks, mustard trousers slightly too long; same costume all episode, no changes.. Register: Seated stillness and calm; the loudness is in the opinion, not the voice; comedy from the gap between certainty and evidence; invites the viewer to argue.
CRITICAL - RELIGHT: discard the reference's lighting; relight to the scene as described per shot, with true contact shadows; must look physically present, never a cut-out.
--- S1 (0.0-6.0s) ---
Location: outside a corner shop on a pavement (generic, unrecognisable). Environment: Pavement outside a corner shop, grey wall and blank shutter behind, damp-free slabs at start, blurred generic passers-by far background, no readable text or brands.
Action: Locked portrait. Uncle Verdict sits on the white chair, left hand gripping the paddle upright on his left thigh with the dial at 2, right palm flat on the closed umbrella across his lap, thin grey rain edge at top of frame. He speaks the verdict; chair, umbrella and paddle stay still.
Performance: Present the verdict like a judge reading a ruling, eyes steady on the lens. Micro-expression: One slow blink on 'ten'; the half-smile does not change.
Camera: medium portrait, centred, seated eye level, 9:16; lens feel phone main lens, about 26mm equivalent; movement propped phone with one small settle-wobble in the first second, then locked; rig phone propped on a low crate at seated eye level
Lighting: Soft overcast key from camera-left top (grey sky); weak fill from the pale shop wall at right; warm mustard bounce from his suit onto the white chair and the paddle; soft contact shadows under chair legs, loafers and the umbrella on his knees. Light stays flat and stable apart from rain darkening.
Audio: ambience quiet street ambience, distant traffic, faint wind; foley: wooden paddle tapping thigh, suit fabric rustle, umbrella canvas shift, exaggerated dial click; no music
Dialogue (Uncle Verdict, on-camera): "Umbrella. Two out of ten. Correct answer: a tiny roof for nobody." - slow, warm, certain; never raises his voice; short pauses after each sentence
--- S2 (6.0-9.0s) ---
Location: outside a corner shop on a pavement (generic, unrecognisable). Environment: Pavement outside a corner shop, grey wall and blank shutter behind, damp-free slabs at start, blurred generic passers-by far background, no readable text or brands.
Action: First drops land on the paddle wood, then on his bald crown, and a generic passer-by's open plain umbrella slides through from the right frame edge, dry underneath. He does not move; paddle, umbrella and chair stay still.
Performance: Hold his verdict against the weather, eyes fixed on the lens, not glancing at the sky. Micro-expression: Drop runs down his forehead; the half-smile and heavy-lidded calm do not change.
Camera: medium portrait, centred, seated eye level, 9:16; lens feel phone main lens, about 26mm equivalent; movement propped phone, locked, no move; rig phone propped on a low crate at seated eye level
Lighting: Soft overcast key from camera-left top (grey sky); weak fill from the pale shop wall at right; warm mustard bounce from his suit onto the white chair and the paddle; soft contact shadows under chair legs, loafers and the umbrella on his knees. Light stays flat and stable apart from rain darkening.
Audio: ambience street ambience as light rain begins, patter on pavement; foley: rain drops on wood, drops on skin, passing umbrella canopy whoosh, soft footstep; no music
--- S3 (9.0-10.5s) ---
Location: outside a corner shop on a pavement (generic, unrecognisable). Environment: Pavement outside a corner shop, grey wall and blank shutter behind, damp-free slabs at start, blurred generic passers-by far background, no readable text or brands.
